content.short: Accept ADA payments. Direct. Secure. From Anywhere. For Everyone.
content.description:
The ADA Pay system comes with a full suite of payment gateway, donations gateway and merchant back-office CRM.

ADA Pay will be embedded in websites, mobile devices, and eventually in Point of Sale systems. Merchants will also be able to accept a payment with ADA and then stake it immediately for staking rewards, creating a positive feedback loop.

Brought to you by COTI.
